violation_type.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System (26 TAC §744.801(17))
violation_type.short_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System
violation_type.typical_finding: A daily tracking system which displays all children signed in for today was not available during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: A daily tracking system which displays all children signed in for today was not available during the inspection.
There were two children that were not signed in on the daily attendance log. There were also three children that were not signed out on the daily attendance log.
